notes.title: Next Closed Beta: June 27 to 30
notes.content:
[h3]A huge thank you to everyone who joined us in May. Your feedback has helped us squash bugs, tweak balance, and polish the experience. We can't wait to see you back in the game!
[/h3]

[h3]Now, onto the last 6 Zodiacs…
[/h3]

[h2]The Zodiac Animals: Meet the Final Six Signs
[/h2]

[h3]The zodiac cycle is made up of twelve animals, each with its own traits and personality. We've already covered the first six—now let’s shine a spotlight on the rest! Do you share a zodiac sign with one of these legendary creatures?[/h3]

[h2]🐴 The Horse
[/h2]Free-spirited and full of adventure, the Horse is known for its energy and determination. If you were born in 1978, 1990, or 2002, you share the sign of this passionate and ambitious traveler, always ready to chase their dreams.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41838134/7a9a948c5b6211751f9afbe3da072398fcc7a9f3.png[/img]

[h2]🐐 The Sheep[/h2]
Born in 1979, 1991, or 2003? Your zodiac sign is the Sheep! Gentle, creative, and compassionate, Sheep have a deep appreciation for art and beauty, making them thoughtful and kind-hearted individuals.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41838134/5f9c23d38014806365b5c96851a35d93206bc08c.png[/img]

[h2]🐵 The Monkey
[/h2]Witty, playful, and full of energy, Monkeys are the life of the party. If you were born in 1980, 1992, or 2004, you share a sign with this clever and mischievous creature who always finds a way to succeed.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41838134/6a75e76fc379d3e4c65c31df46bbd63c48aac221.png[/img]

[h2]🐔 The Rooster
[/h2]Born in 1981, 1993, or 2005? You’re a Rooster—hardworking, confident, and always up for a challenge! Roosters are known for their sharp minds, strong sense of responsibility, and eye for detail.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41838134/045816b2ea5fd1fc1e8c118e002fdf0c452dc218.png[/img]

[h2]🐶 The Dog
[/h2]Loyal, honest, and protective—Dogs are natural friends and guardians. If you were born in 1982, 1994, or 2006, you share a sign with this devoted and courageous companion.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41838134/090c99f141c9fd45cdffc4901744dcbf28df586b.png[/img]

[h2]🐗 The Pig
[/h2]Born in 1983, 1995, or 2007? Your zodiac sign is the Pig! Pigs are kind, generous, and easygoing, known for their warm hearts and strong sense of responsibility. They bring joy and loyalty to those around them.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41838134/936fd4bd6016ee0ce22d0b1e551bbfe84102cef2.png[/img]

A big thank you to everyone who joined us during this Beta period! We received lots of valuable feedback and had an amazing time watching your streams and games of Lunars. It was so exciting to see the community come together and share in the fun!
We can’t wait to show you what’s coming next!

Now that we’ve covered all twelve zodiac animals, which one do you relate to the most? 
🐉🐍🐯🐰🐭🐂🐴🐐🐵🐔🐶🐗

notes.title: Lunars Closed Beta: May 23–26! 🚨
notes.content:
[h3]We’re back with another weekend of plushie-powered chaos! The May Closed Beta runs from May 23 to 26, and it’s packed with familiar fun and exciting new features.[/h3]

[h2]Returning Features[/h2]
[list]
[*] 4 wild boards to outsmart your friends (or enemies)
[*] 30+ minigames to win, lose, and absolutely scream over
[*] 3 game modes, including the fast-paced, no-wait Blitz Mode
[*] Online multiplayer and local co-op so you can play together wherever you are
[/list]
[h2]New in May[/h2]
[list]
[*] New outfits to dress up your plushies in style
[*] A brand new emote system (starting with our expressive dragon!)
[*] Early support for custom game settings so you can tweak matches your way
[*] Visual updates to several minigames
[*] New language support: Traditional Chinese, Polish, and Hungarian
[*] General improvements based on your April feedback including UI polish, improved stability, and early host migration support (still in testing)
[/list]
[h2]How to play[/h2]
If you played in April, you’re already in! Just update your build when the beta goes live on May 23.

[b]If you're new:[/b]
[list]
[*] Sign up on Steam for a chance to join
[*] Wishlist the game to support us
[*] Join our Discord for updates and bonus beta key drops
[/list]
[h2]Share Your Best Moments![/h2]
Caught a chaotic minigame moment? Emoted at the perfect time? We’d love to see it!
Share your clips in the #clips channel on Discord or tag us on socials. We’re making another recap video and might feature your gameplay (with credit, of course)!

[h2]Wishlist & Leave a Demo Review[/h2]
We're a small two-person team, and every bit of support helps. If you're enjoying Lunars, review the demo and don't forget to wishlist the game on Steam. It boosts visibility and means the world to us as we work toward launch!

notes.title: 📢 Lunars Closed Beta returns April 25–28!
notes.content:
[h2]We’re gearing up for our next Closed Beta and we’ve got lots of new chaos coming your way. Mark your calendars for April 25–28![/h2]

[h3]What's In The Beta:[/h3]

[list]
[*] 🌙 4 unique boards to explore and battle across
[*] 🎉 30 minigames to win, lose, and scream over
[*] ⚡ 3 game modes, including Blitz Mode — our fast-paced, all-action mode with no waiting around
[*] 👯‍♀️ Both online multiplayer and local co-op (yes, you can play on the couch and online)
[*] 💬 Improved stability, matchmaking, and UI updates based on your March feedback
[/list]

[h3]How to Get Access:[/h3]

🔑 If you played in the March beta, you’re already in — just update when the new build drops on April 25th.

[b]If you don't have access yet, no worries![/b]
[list]
[*] 🎮 Sign up on Steam for a chance to join
[*] 💛 Wishlist the game to support the devs
[*] 💬 [url=https://discord.gg/SFcCyMzgDV]Join our Discord[/url] for updates and extra beta key drops
[/list]

[h3]Send Us Your Best Moments![/h3]

Caught a hilarious fail? Pulled off the ultimate plushie play? We’d love to see it!
If you capture any fun clips during the beta, send them our way — we’re putting together beta recap videos and may feature your gameplay on social media (with credit, of course)!

🎥 Drop your clips in the #clips channel on Discord or tag us on socials. Let’s show off the chaos together!

[b]💛 Thank you![/b]
We’re a small, two-person team, and your feedback during these beta weekends helps us build the best possible version of Lunars before launch. Thanks again for being part of this wild little community 💛

notes.title: Happy Lunar New Year from Lunars! 🎊🐍
notes.content:
[h1]Happy Lunar New Year from Lunars! 🎊🐍[/h1]

[h2]The Year of the Wood Snake is here! To celebrate, we're introducing a special Wood Snake skin—slither into the festivities in style! 🐍✨
[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41838134/d3259723dd9a5f6e127c934f1d2e997573958520.jpg[/img]

The Lunar New Year marks a time of renewal, reflection, and celebration, and what better way to honour it than by exploring the Chinese Zodiac? The zodiac cycle is made up of twelve animals, each with its own traits and personality. We're shining a spotlight on six of these legendary creatures—do you share a zodiac sign with one of them?


[h2]🐍 The Snake 
[/h2][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41838134/48ffb8fe0383ebe3fc9c34b17a60e1122caabeeb.jpg[/img]
Born in 1989, 2001, or 2013? Your zodiac sign is the Snake! Known for being wise, intuitive, and sophisticated, Snakes are natural strategists who approach life with careful thought and charm.

[h2]🐲 The Dragon
[/h2][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41838134/b94f2320da745c0cd8f915a05911c6ca1313156b.jpg[/img]
The fifth animal in the cycle, Dragons are confident, charismatic, and dynamic. Born in 1988, 2000, or 2012? You share the sign of this legendary creature, often seen as a symbol of strength and luck.

[h2]🐰 The Rabbit
[/h2][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41838134/8abca2f92a7f6f6e6a79d2403e1037b9255e00c6.jpg[/img]
Born in 1987, 1999, or 2011? You’re a Rabbit—gentle, quick-witted, and graceful. Rabbits bring kindness and harmony wherever they go, making them beloved among friends and family.

[h2]🐯 The Tiger
[/h2][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41838134/121e348907d5292c340f72b2e8ab8daf9d55b0a7.jpg[/img]
Tigers are bold, courageous, and confident, always ready to take on new challenges. If you were born in 1986, 1998, or 2010, you share the fierce and determined spirit of the Tiger!

[h2]🐂 The Ox
[/h2][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41838134/fa97a78fd75353030afeebb0df95444a55a3c20c.jpg[/img]
Dependable and hardworking, the Ox represents resilience and perseverance. If you were born in 1985, 1997, or 2009, your sign is the Ox—strong, steady, and always ready to put in the effort.

[h2]🐭 The Rat
[/h2][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41838134/b1f96f23f793366a78a4aa8f5ba385d5c9497a28.jpg[/img]
The very first animal in the Chinese Zodiac, the Rat is known for its cleverness, charm, and resourcefulness. Born in 1984, 1996, or 2008? You share a sign with the cunning creature who outsmarted them all to take the top spot!

[h2]Wishing you prosperity, happiness, and good fortune in the year ahead! 💖[/h2]

As we step into the Year of the Wood Snake, we want to thank our amazing community for being part of this journey! Which zodiac sign do you belong to? Let us know in the discussion and join us in celebrating this festive season! 🎉🐉🐰🐯🐂🐭

tags.feature: To celebrate, we're introducing a special Wood Snake skin—slither into the festivities in style! 🐍✨
